differences: Independent Chromium review found queue filters remain visible on alternate panes because display:grid overrides hidden.
Refresh completion must preserve interaction that begins during the API request.
suggestions: Explicitly hide filters on alternate panes and assert their computed visibility.
Defer DOM replacement when an input/dialog becomes active during refresh, and add delayed-response regression coverage.
reasoning: Final queue screenshots now have legible status/action metadata, correct sidebar contrast and responsive hierarchy. Two interaction defects found by hostile review remain to fix.
